title: A method of moving planes for a mixed local-nonlocal parabolic system with quenching
summary: In this paper we develop a parabolic version of the method of moving planes on systems with a mixed local and nonlocal diffusion operator, that being $\mathcal{L} = -(-Δ)^s + Δ$, where $(-Δ)^s$ is the integral fractional laplacian. We then use this result to study the quenching phenomena occurring in said systems with a singular absorption term of the type $(1-u)^{-p}$.
